name: bf-company-property-tax
description: Burkina Faso annual company property tax workpaper for the 2026 tax year, covering the taxe foncière des sociétés under CGI articles 251 to 257. Use for questions about SA, SAS and SARL property ownership, usufruct, the January ownership test, owner-occupied buildings, rental valuation, major repairs paid by tenants and construction leases. It calculates the statutory rental-value base and tax, distinguishes two ordinary exemptions, lists the annual occupancy declaration contents and applies the separately checked 2026 penalty amendment. Two executable cases show the ordinary computation and the deduction boundary. Current valuation evidence, the administration's form and payment calendar, special investment exemptions and foreign entity classification still require further work.
